title: Postgres DestinationSystem Config
description:
Config node for a Postgres-backed DestinationSystem.

Contains connection details and transaction settings.

one_transaction.title: One Transaction
one_transaction.description: Whether to execute all operations within a single transaction.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Connection details for the Postgres database.

host.title: Host
host.description: The hostname of the Postgres server.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port number of the Postgres server.

dbname.title: Database Name
dbname.description: The name of the Postgres database.

user.title: User
user.description: The username for authenticating with the Postgres database.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password for authenticating with the Postgres database.
